title: One helper each for the turn-check producer digest and for persist-fence read-back
outcome: The producer-observation digest 'termal-turn-check:{session}:{grant}:{sequence}:{key}' is built by one helper (engram_batch_producer_observation_id), which engram_turn_report and test_run_evidence call, so batch binds can never silently stop matching their gate's record. confirm_engram_owed_close_durable calls the general confirm_persist_fence_target rather than keeping its own copy of the fence and read-back logic.
acceptance: One helper each for the turn-check producer digest and for persist-fence read-back is done
